data.description: FENDI Interiors | Palm Skyline & Bluewaters View
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional 3-bedroom penthouse in Damac Heights, Dubai Marina. Offering an unparalleled combination of luxury, space, and breathtaking views, this fully furnished residence is designed for those seeking an elevated waterfront lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most prestigious addresses.


  Spanning an impressive 3,550 sq. ft., this remarkable penthouse features exquisite Fendi-designed interiors, expansive living and dining spaces, and a spectacular oversized balcony that captures uninterrupted panoramic views of Palm Jumeirah, Bluewaters Island, Dubai Marina, and the Arabian Gulf. Every detail has been carefully curated to deliver a refined and sophisticated living experience.


  Property Details:


 3 Bedrooms
 4 Bathrooms
 Built-up Area: 3,550 sq. ft.
 Fully Furnished
 Exclusive Fendi Interior Design
 Large Private Balcony / Terrace
 Panoramic Palm Jumeirah, Bluewaters & Marina Views
 Bright Open-Plan Layout
 2 Covered Parking Spaces
 Ready to Move In


  Building Amenities:


 Swimming Pool
 Children's Pool
 Fully Equipped Gymnasium
 Spa Facilities
 Children's Play Area
 Elegant Lobby
 24/7 Security & CCTV Monitoring


  Location Highlights – Dubai Marina
  Located in the iconic Damac Heights tower, residents enjoy direct access to the vibrant Dubai Marina lifestyle. Surrounded by luxury waterfront dining, premium retail destinations, yacht clubs, and entertainment venues, the tower is just minutes from Marina Walk, Palm Jumeirah, Bluewaters Island, and Sheikh Zayed Road. With excellent connectivity and world-class amenities at your doorstep, this is urban luxury living at its finest.


  Annual Rent: AED 370,000
